      description: Persisted selection metadata; contributes no fallback text and cannot receive reactions.
    DataPart:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      description: |
        A2A's DataPart (`Part { data; media_type }`) holding A2UI v0.9.1
        messages (https://a2ui.org). A message may carry any number of data
        parts beside its other parts. A `media_type` other than
        `application/a2ui+json` returns 422.

        This is Relay's REST shape for the part. The A2A door, when it opens,
        carries the same part as A2A's DataPart: `data` unchanged, and
        `media_type` as the Part's `mediaType` (A2A specification, Part).

        Relay processes every A2UI message in order, as the A2UI A2A extension
        says a receiver must: each valid one is applied, and each that fails is
        returned in the response's `a2ui_errors` (see `A2uiFailure`), in A2UI's
        own error format. A send that applies nothing is refused with the first
        failure's status (404, 409 or 422) and `a2ui_errors`. Relay checks each
        message against A2UI v0.9.1's schemas, and each component and
        `createSurface` theme against the catalog its surface names: a
        component the catalog does not define, a property it does not define,
        a value outside its type or enum, or a missing required property fails
        with `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

        **createSurface, updateComponents, updateDataModel, deleteSurface**
        (from an agent; a person sending one gets 403, error code `2003`):
        - `createSurface` makes a surface in this chat, drawn by this message.
          `catalogId` must be one Relay draws (see `A2uiClientCapabilities`).
          A `surfaceId` already live in the chat fails with 409; once deleted
          it may be created again. The surface's first `updateComponents` must
          hold the component with `id` `root`; later ones need not repeat it.
        - Any agent in the chat may send the other three for any surface in
          it. A surface made by an earlier message changes in place: its
          message is re-projected to every member, and the send adds no
          message unless it carries other parts (a `text` part, for example,
          which becomes an ordinary message). An unknown or deleted
          `surfaceId` fails with 404.
        - `deleteSurface` removes the surface. When every surface a message
          draws is deleted, the message is removed for everyone: it reads back
          with no parts and a non-null `unsent_at`.
        - `PaymentRequest` (Relay's catalog only; `checkoutUrl` required) names
          one of your payment requests by `checkoutUrl`, exactly what
          `POST /v1/payment_requests` returned,
          under the `payment` part's rules: a request that is not yours fails
          with 404, one no longer `requested` with 409, and the digital-goods
          storefront rule with 422. Relay writes the request's state into the
          surface's data model at `/relay/payments/<h>` (`<h>` the lowercase
          hex SHA-256 of `checkoutUrl`) as `{status, amount, currency}`, with
          an `updateDataModel` when the component is accepted and again when
          the request settles. The payer's receipt replies to the data part
          that created the surface holding the request.
        - Image, Video and AudioPlayer `url`s are delivered exactly as sent.
        - With no `text` part, the chat list and notification show the text of
          the first `Text` component, in tree order from `root`.

        **action, error** (from a person or an agent) travel in the message
        itself, and reach only the sender and the agent that created the
        surface they name (A2UI's "Targeted Delivery": "sent exclusively to the
        server that created the surface"); every other reader's copy of the
        part leaves them out, and a message that holds nothing else is not
        delivered to other agents at all. Each names a live surface in the
        chat. An `action`'s `sourceComponentId` must be a Button there and its
        `name` that Button's `action.event.name`. A text part and `reply_to`
        are optional, and a text part reaches every member. When the surface
        set `sendDataModel`, the message must carry
        `metadata.a2uiClientDataModel`.
      required: [type, media_type, data]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [data]
        media_type:
          type: string
          enum: [application/a2ui+json]
        data:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          description: A2UI v0.9.1 messages, in order.
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: true
    DataPartResponse:
      type: object
      description: |
        A data part as a reader receives it: the `action` and `error`
        messages it carried, as sent, when the reader sent them or created the
        surface they name (empty otherwise); then, for each surface it created,
        every A2UI message accepted for that surface since, in order, exactly
        as sent (Relay's own `updateDataModel` for a `PaymentRequest`
        included). A reader replays the list to draw the surface; a late or
        second device receives the whole list.
      required: [type, media_type, data, reactions]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [data]
        media_type:
          type: string
          enum: [application/a2ui+json]
        data:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: true
        reactions:
          type:
            - array
            - "null"
          description: Reactions on this message part
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Reaction"
    A2uiFailure:

            message:
              type: string
    MessageMetadata:

    PaymentPart:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      description: "A request to pay, drawn as a card. `checkout_url` is the only field: pass back exactly what `POST /v1/payment_requests` returned. The card's amount and title are read from that request, never from the message, so a card cannot show a figure its checkout will not charge. Sent only by the agent that created the request, while it is `requested`; must be the only part of its message. Another sender gets 403 (error code `2003`); a checkout_url that is not one of your requests gets 404; a request that is no longer `requested` gets 409. A request with `category=digital_goods` sent to a person whose devices report only storefronts outside the United States returns 422 (error code `2006`)."

    PaymentReceiptPartResponse:
      type: object
      description: "The payer's receipt. When a payment request succeeds, Relay adds one message from the person who paid at the bottom of the chat, a reply to the `payment` card, carrying this part; your agent receives it as `message.received` like any message. The payer is the person who opened the payment in the Relay app, or, when Relay does not know who paid, the one person in a chat that holds the card. A group chat with no known payer gets no receipt. Expired and canceled requests add no message. Only Relay writes this part; sending one returns 400."
      required: [type, payment_request_id, description, amount, currency, mode, reactions]

    PaymentCategory:
      type: string
      enum: [physical_goods, digital_goods, donation]
      description: |-
        What is being paid for, the same three values as PayPal Orders v2 `items[].category` (PHYSICAL_GOODS, DIGITAL_GOODS, DONATION; developer.paypal.com/docs/api/orders/v2/). The App Store Review Guidelines (developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/) decide where each can be paid:
        - `physical_goods`: physical goods, and services used in the real world, such as a haircut or a ride (3.1.3(e)). Payable anywhere.
        - `digital_goods`: anything used in an app or online. A person pays by opening the link in Safari, and only on the United States storefront (3.1.1(a)); sending one to a person whose devices report only other storefronts returns 422 (error code `2006`). A tip to an agent or a creator is `digital_goods` (3.1.1: tips to digital content providers use In-App Purchase).
        - `donation`: money for a charity or a fundraiser. Collected outside the app, on any storefront (3.2.2(iv): such apps "may only collect funds outside of the app, such as via Safari…").
    PaymentDiscount:

      additionalProperties: false
      description: Subscription mode only. One coupon or one promotion code from your connected Stripe account, never both.
      properties:

          type: string

          type: string
          description: The id of a promotion code (`promo_...`), not the code a customer types.
        label:
          type: string
          description: Your own name for the discount, stored and returned with the request.

            created_at.

            - type: "null"

      type: object
      description: One message containing 1–100 ordered parts. A link must be the only part.             Message. Reusing the key with a different body returns a conflict.
          maxLength: 255

          default: false

            still counts as unread, and still moves the Chat to the top of the list.

      description: |
        A2UI's own handshake (`a2uiClientCapabilities`, shaped by A2UI v0.9.1's
        `client_capabilities.json`, whose key is the protocol family `v0.9`):
        the A2UI catalogs Relay's app draws, in order of preference. Pick the
        first catalog your agent can write for a card's `createSurface.catalogId`.
        - `https://relayapp.im/a2ui/catalog/v1`, Relay's catalog: every basic
          catalog component and function, plus `PaymentRequest` (see `DataPart`).
        - `https://a2ui.org/specification/v0_9/catalogs/basic/catalog.json`,
          the A2UI v0.9.1 basic catalog.

        Relay's catalog only grows: new components and optional properties are
        added to v1, nothing is removed from it, and a breaking change would get a
        new id (`.../catalog/v2`), listed beside v1.

              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              example:

    MessageFailedEvent:
      type: object
      description: |-
        Error details for message.failed webhook events.

        Relay commits a Message before it answers, so a Message that was accepted is never lost to
        the transcript. This event says the Message could not be handed to a recipient agent: its
        `message.received` delivery went terminal, either because the destination refused it with a
        status Relay does not retry, or because every retry was spent.

            - "null"

            status the destination answered with, or null when it never answered. Log it and
            include it in support requests, but do not branch on it.
        failed_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the failure was detected

    ThreadOriginator:
      type: object
      description: The Message and part that opened a thread. A reply to a reply names the same originator as the Message it
        replied to, so every Message in one thread carries the same value. Withheld, as null on the Message, from a reader who
        cannot see the originator.

    ReplyTo:
      type: object
      description: Indicates this message is a threaded reply to another message
      required:
        - message_id
      properties:
        message_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: The ID of the message to reply to
        part_index:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          description: |
            The specific message part to reply to (0-based index).
            Defaults to 0 (first part) if not provided.
            Use this when replying to a specific part of a multipart message.
            Targeting a `buttons` part returns 422 unless the message is a tap:
            one `text` part equal to one of that part's plain button labels,
            sent by the user. An agent's reply to a `buttons` part returns 403.
            A selection response must explicitly supply this index and target a
            `selection` part. Only a user may answer, with exactly plain text
            then `selection_response` metadata. Malformed shapes return 400/1005;
            mismatched source values, order or text return 422/2006; an already
            consumed selection with a different key returns 409/1005.
            Same-key retries return the original Message, under normal Message
            idempotency and authorization rules.
          minimum: 0
    RequestUploadRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - filename
        - content_type
        - size_bytes
      properties:
        filename:
          type: string
          description: Name of the file to upload
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        content_type:
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+/[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+$"
          description: >-
            MIME type of the file, as `type/subtype`. Relay accepts any file
            type and stores the bytes unchanged; the declared type is lowercased
            and returned to the reader as sent.
        size_bytes:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Size of the file in bytes (max 100MB)
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 104857600
        duration_ms:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 0
          description: >-
            Audio or video duration in milliseconds when known. Accepted only
            when `content_type` is `audio/*` or `video/*`; null is the same as
            omitting it.
        width:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: >-
            Pixel width when known. Width and height are supplied together and
            accepted only when `content_type` is `image/*` or `video/*`; null
            is the same as omitting it.
        height:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: >-
            Pixel height when known. Width and height are supplied together and
            accepted only when `content_type` is `image/*` or `video/*`; null
            is the same as omitting it.
    RequestUploadResult:
      type: object
      required:
        - attachment_id
        - upload_url
        - download_url
        - http_method
        - expires_at
        - required_headers
      properties:
        attachment_id:

        download_url:
          type: string

        trace_id:
          type: string

        data:
          type: object
          description: Event payload. Its shape is selected by event_type.
          additionalProperties: true

    schemas-TextPartResponse:
      type: object
      description: A text message part
      required:
        - type
        - value
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - text
          description: Indicates this is a text message part
        value:
          type: string
          description: The text content
        mentions:
          type:
            - array
            - "null"
          description: Mentions ordered by position in the text; null when none. Handles reflect the participant's current handle.
          items:
            type: object
            required: [id, handle, is_me, range]
            properties:
              id:
                type: string
                format: uuid
                description: Stable participant Contact ID, unchanged when the handle changes.
              handle:
                type: string
                description: The target participant's current Relay Handle.
              is_me:
                type: boolean
                description: Whether the mention addresses the recipient reading this message.
              range:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 0
                minItems: 2
                maxItems: 2
                description: Inclusive-exclusive [start, end) UTF-16 code-unit range in value; the whole value when the send omitted mention_range.
        mention:
          deprecated: true
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
        mention_range:
          deprecated: true
          type:
            - array
            - "null"
          items:
            type: integer
          minItems: 2
          maxItems: 2
          description: |
            Character range `[start, end)` in `value` highlighted as the mention, as sent.
            `null` when the send omitted it (the whole `value` is highlighted) or the part
            carries no mention.
            *Characters are measured as UTF-16 code units. Most characters count as 1; some emoji count as 2.*

    TooManyMessages:
      description: |-
        The sender is posting too fast. Relay caps one sender at 10 messages
        in 10 seconds in one conversation and 300 in 10 seconds across all of
        them, which allows a burst and then refuses with error code `2008`.
        Wait `retry_after` seconds, which the `Retry-After` header repeats,
        and send again. Nothing was stored, so a retry cannot duplicate the
        Message.
      headers:
        Retry-After:
          description: Seconds to wait before sending again.
          schema:
            type: integer
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
          example:
            error:
              status: 429
              code: 2008
              message: Too many messages. Try again shortly.
              doc_url: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2008
              retry_after: 10
            success: false
    Unauthorized:
      description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid authentication
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
    UnprocessableEntity:
      description: Unprocessable Entity - request is valid but cannot be processed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
  securitySchemes:

      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      description: |

        Format: `Authorization: Bearer <your-token>`

x-relay-websocket-close-codes:
  "1011": Relay could not load or commit delivery state; reconnect and resume.
  "1012": Relay is restarting; reconnect and resume.
  "4401": The Agent Token is invalid or revoked.
  "4408": The heartbeat timed out.
  "4410": Webhook delivery is now configured for this Agent.
